correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the Tutte–Coxeter incidence graph from 15 duads and 15 synthemes on six labels, a cubic bipartite 30-vertex 45-edge graph of girth eight. Independent full face traversal and separate summation over 2^15 duad subsets agree on all 476,187 independent faces, augmented face-cardinality vector (1,30,390,2890,13515,41736,86610,120690,111225,66090,24948,6420,1370,240,30,2). Independently implemented greedy pivot matching v=0..29 on the augmented poset, yielding 238,089 disjoint pairs, nine unmatched size-nine faces, plus pair empty ↔ {0}. Complete directed cover graph topological sort across all 476,187 faces verifies acyclicity, not just correct pair counts. Removing augmented empty pair gives one critical vertex and nine critical 8-cells and no intermediate cells, hence the CW Morse model is integrally wedge of nine S^8. The 14-dimensional original simplices do not invalidate Morse reduction.
